thread:
Clara: Quick follow-up from the postmortem thread — we've got a cluster of recurring failures linked to TTL drift + retry amplification. I propose a two-week remediation cohort with clear stewards, a short handoff template, and an explicit regression test added to CI.

Mason: +1. can we also rotate a reviewer to avoid review bottlenecks? suggest a steward + reviewer per ticket.

Eloise: I'll draft the tickets. Proposed: RW-9001 (ttl-drift-detection), RW-9002 (retry-throttling), RW-9003 (fallback-routing-canary), RW-9004 (alert-dedupe-tuning).

Clara: Nice. Here's a compact RACI for the cohort:
```
Ticket    Responsible   Accountable   Consulted     Informed
RW-9001   Mason         Clara         Observability Eng+Support
RW-9002   Devon         Clara         Infra,QA      Eng+Support
RW-9003   Eloise        Mason         Routing       Eng+Support
RW-9004   TBD           Clara         Support       Eng+Support
```

assign-bot: Parent ticket RW-9100 (postmortem-cohort-gamma) created and linked. Next checkpoint: 5 business days.

Mason: I'll own RW-9001 and add ACs + a small detector that flags >5s drift in prod metrics. Will include a rollback.

Devon: Taking RW-9002. I'll add throttling config + staging canary. Also propose a CI regression: simulate 10k qps with jitter to catch amplification. QA-bot, can we add an automated job?

QA-bot: CI job request noted. Please attach test manifest to RW-9100. Job scheduled on staging nightly for the cohort window.

Eloise: RW-9003: will create a canary plan (us-west canary, 0.5% traffic) and coordinate infra review. tagging @Devon for throttling interplay.

Clara: Hand-off checklist (minimal): 1) Jira with ACs + rollback plan, 2) 2-sentence incident excerpt, 3) runbook link + failing logs, 4) smoke test commands, 5) two pairing slots. Put that in RW-9100 comments.

Mason: Action items:
- Mason: ACs + detector for RW-9001 (48h)
- Devon: throttling + CI manifest for RW-9002 (72h)
- Eloise: canary plan for RW-9003 + infra review (48h)
- Clara: create RW-9004 after support triage + post RACI in RW-9100 (72h)

Devon: Also noting recurring pattern: TTL drift spikes align with large burst write windows. I'll add a short postmortem excerpt to RW-9100 so stewards don't rediscover the timeline.

assign-bot: Checkpoint set: cohort tickets RW-9001..9004 added to sprint board. Reminder will post in 5 business days.

Clara: Thanks all. Please update tickets with blockers and ping this thread for escalations. :thumbsup:
